summary: Diphtheria toxoid is the antigen in all diphtheria-containing vaccines (pentavalent, DPT, DT, Td). It is also used as the carrier protein in some conjugate vaccines (for example Hib).
indications: Primary immunisation and boosters against diphtheria, as part of combination vaccines

dosage.n: DPT boosters at 16 to 24 months and 5 to 6 years

dosage.d: Td 0.5 mL at 10 and 16 years; pregnancy per UIP

admin: Anterolateral thigh in infants, deltoid in older children and adults
moa: Induces antitoxin antibodies that neutralise diphtheria toxin.

absolute: Anaphylaxis to a previous dose or component

preg: Td is given in pregnancy per UIP
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Resume the schedule; do not restart the series.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
refs: IAP Advisory Committee on Vaccines and Immunization Practices
